name: damdit
description: Run and explain Damdit website audits from your agent: what is wrong with a site, what to fix first, what changed since the last audit and whether a fix worked. Works with Damdit for Mac (damdit) and Damdit CLI (damdit-cli).

interface.shortDescription: Website audits with the evidence behind every issue
interface.longDescription: Runs Damdit's Full Audit of a website on your computer and explains the result: SEO, accessibility, performance, security and AI readiness, the evidence behind every issue, what could not be checked, and what changed since the last audit. Needs Damdit for Mac or Damdit CLI installed on the same computer.
defaultPrompt: Audit example.com with Damdit and tell me what to fix first.
What changed on my website since the last Damdit audit?
